text:
Morgan Chen: seeing strange SSE connections that stay OPEN but stop emitting events for ~10m, then server closes with 204. Users see reconnect floods and console shows 'active' for the tenant the whole time.
Priya Patel: repro steps?
Morgan Chen: start a stream w/ `Accept: text/event-stream`, send ~500 concurrent connections from our test harness, then pause event generation on the host side for 8-12m.
Danilo Ruiz: hmm we recently added the idle-ping suppression to avoid noisy heartbeats when tenant has 0 requests. Could be related.
Avery Kim: any specific logs? sample: `SSE_CONN keepalive_suppressed=true last_emit=2025-11-03T15:22:07Z state=OPEN tenant=acme-corp`
Morgan Chen: yes that exactly. After pause we get `state=OPEN` in agent, but the proxy returns 204 on close. Console chart shows connection count stable then a big spike in reconnects after close.
Priya Patel: console probably shows the connection as active until server sends final close event. We might be missing a telemetry event when we suppress the pings that would otherwise reveal idle state.
Danilo Ruiz: agree. I think we only emit `sse.idle_detected` when we send a ping. If ping suppressed we never tag it and console -> route inspector keeps it as active.
Avery Kim: quick fix: emit `sse.idle_probe_suppressed` metric at suppression time and mark session as `parked` in trace. That way the console can display a parked state.
Sasha (ops-bot): created ticket PLAT-4328 for "SSE parked state telemetry + console marker" assigned to eng-platform.
Morgan Chen: can we also add a small TTL on the agent side so agents mark OPEN but quiet sessions as STALE after 9m? Then the proxy would close earlier and we'd avoid reconnection floods.
Danilo Ruiz: cautious about premature closes; some long-poll clients legitimately quiet. But we could make TTL tenant-configurable and default 12m.
Priya Patel: request: add a telemetry dimension `sse.lifecycle_reason` with values [emit, ping, idle_ttl, manual_close]. Console can then break down reconnect spikes by lifecycle_reason.
Avery Kim: I'll prototype emitting `sse.lifecycle_reason=idle_ttl` when agent-side TTL triggers and `sse.idle_probe_suppressed=true` when we suppress. Also add a console badge to route inspector showing `parked` sessions count.
Morgan Chen: +1. Also add a small note in rollout playbook: if you enable suppression, set idle_ttl >= suppression window to avoid double-closing.
Danilo Ruiz: small API debate — should this be a tenant routing policy or agent runtime change? I vote runtime change (agent) with opt-out via routing policy so infra teams can override.
Priya Patel: makes sense. Runtime default, override via `sse.config.idle_ttl` in tenant policy.
Avery Kim: we'll do agent change + console telemetry + policy support. I'll open PRs for agent and console mockups.
Sasha (ops-bot): PRs requested: agent repo #887, console repo #412.
Morgan Chen: thanks. Can we get a small metric shard to query parked sessions over the past 24h for acme-corp to baseline? I'll paste results in thread when ready. :eyes:
